title: Implement immutable local Module lifecycle operations
goal: Provide deterministic local Module lifecycle operations over immutable built-ins and extension candidates without marketplace or activation authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory inspect and graph expose provenance hashes compatibility Stages capabilities prerequisites Profile usage and dependencies.
Scaffold writes metadata only below StateRoot and leaves adapter source to repository or IDE work.
Validate and test fail closed on schema hash lock placement capability prerequisite timeout fixture and Target mutation errors.
Diff pack and review preparation produce deterministic EvidenceRoot candidates and refuse built-in replacement.
Compose and verify are exact handoffs to existing authorities and no installation is selected published downloaded or remotely activated.
risks: Lifecycle tooling could mutate built-in Package authority or TargetRoot.
A deterministic bundle could be mistaken for reviewed production acceptance or trusted Evidence.
decisions: Keep built-ins immutable and write extension candidates only below StateRoot or EvidenceRoot.
Reuse existing compose and verification authorities rather than creating a second installation engine.
